en: Black‑and‑white image showing four mounted soldiers in formal cavalry uniforms lined up in the foreground of an open field. Each rider carries a lance with a small flag and wears a tall shako-style hat with an emblem on the front. One rider is pointing into the distance while the others look ahead. In the hazy background are low buildings and more mounted troops on parade, suggesting a military exercise or review.
